sentences.text: In a retrospective study, two blinded neurosurgeons independently evaluated MRI scans from 53 patients to assess tumor characteristics.

The Knosp grade emerged as the strongest predictor for complete tumor removal, while none of the 16 patients with a wide tumor-arachnoid cleft larger than 2 millimeters experienced fluid leakage during surgery.

The authors conclude that the finding regarding the cleft grade remains a preliminary hypothesis requiring future testing, as it is not yet proven to add useful information beyond existing height measurements.
